name: Dodger Blue
lede: Dodger Blue is a bright, saturated azure from the X11 color list, one of the web's standard blues.

sections.title: A listed color
sections.body:
Paterson's dictionary lists DodgerBlue as an entry in the X11 Color Set, with hex code 1E90FF [1]. His index files it with the blues, between Delft blue and the Dresden blue entries [2]. Our name records list CSS and the xkcd list of 2010 [3]. Where the name comes from is undocumented in our sources, and we do not guess at it.

Its nearest neighbors among our names, by CIELAB distance, are [[soft-blue|Soft Blue]], [[azure|Azure]] and [[cornflower|Cornflower]] [5]. On a white page it reaches a contrast ratio of 3.24:1 [5].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our archive of 23,781 paintings has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of this swatch covering at least 1% of its canvas, as photographed [4]. That describes the archive, not painting as a whole, and it says nothing against the color: it is a screen color first, and museum photographs rarely hold it.
